fields.description: Set by Crema Settings.validate from interfaces.LABELS — never typed by hand.
fields.label: Interface

fields.description: The key passed to ask("<this>", ...) etc. Set by Crema Settings.validate from interfaces.names() — never typed by hand.
fields.label: Interface Key

fields.description: Blank uses Crema Settings' Default Provider; if that's blank too, this interface falls back per interfaces.fallback_for(). An effective provider (this or the default) requires an effective isolation user (this row's or the default's) — see CremaSettings.validate.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Blank uses Crema Settings' Default Model. Greyed out until this row's own Provider is selected — model list is fetched from that provider.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Spend this calendar month against this row's effective budget (own, else Crema Settings' Default Monthly Budget). Never stored — painted client-side from crema.api.get_usage on every grid refresh.
fields.label: Usage

fields.description: Sandbox identity — must not be Administrator. All document access during this interface's calls is fenced by this user's roles and User Permissions. Blank uses Crema Settings' Default Isolation User.
fields.label: Isolation User

fields.description: This interface's spend this calendar month, summed from Crema Log.cost_usd. 0 = unlimited. A call that would exceed this is blocked before the provider is called.
fields.label: Monthly Budget (USD)

fields.description: Caps the response length passed to the provider. 0 = provider default (unset).
fields.label: Max Tokens

fields.description: Response cache TTL in seconds. 0 disables response caching.
fields.label: Cache TTL (seconds)

fields.description: Layer 1: regex/unicode prompt scan, always local, never calls an LLM.
fields.label: Enable Prompt Scan

fields.description: Layer 2: routes the prompt through the 'security' interface for an LLM risk classification. Requires the 'security' interface to be configured (a Provider assigned). Forced off on the 'security' interface itself to avoid recursion.
fields.label: Enable LLM Guard

fields.description: Layer 3: asks the model to echo a per-call random token, and checks it came back. Off — no token sent, no cost. Log Only — record the miss, return the response anyway. Retry Once — one fresh attempt, then block. Block — a missing or echoed token blocks the call.
fields.label: Output Trap
fields.options:
Off
Log Only
Retry Once
Block

fields.description: Auto-filled from the built-in default for predefined interface names if left empty.
fields.label: System Prompt
